response.content: {"critique": "The problem is that reserve adjustments get stuck when the sole required approver is unavailable with no delegate. I checked the five most similar items: the document classifier threshold story (4133), the reserve history audit export roadmap page, payment history improvements (4130), task list improvements (4134), and activity timeline display (4132). None of these address approver availability, delegation, or approval workflow blocking; the closest, the reserve history audit export, only covers exporting an audit trail of adjustments, not unblocking stuck approvals. No shipped story or roadmap item solves this problem.", "verdict": "pass"}
